cards.front: Recall a key point about Using Quotations
cards.back: Every point you make needs evidence. "Show, don't just tell." A quotation shows exactly what the writer did.

cards.front: What should you know about technique?
cards.back: Introduce the quotation with your own words, then quote only the key words. The quotation becomes part of YOUR sentence.

cards.front: What should you know about recommended?
cards.back: 5-8 key quotations per major text. Choose quotations that can be used for multiple themes or characters. Quality over quantity.

cards.front: What should you know about top tip?
cards.back: In closed-book exams, quotation recall under time pressure is critical. Spend the first 5 minutes of planning time jotting down the 3-4 quotations you will use. This prevents you forgetting key quotes mid-essay and ensures every paragraph has evidence ready before you start writing.

Can be used for multiple points

cards.front: What does Macbeth is ambitious. "I have no spur to prick the sides of my intent, but vaulting ambition." mean?
cards.back: Macbeth acknowledges that he has "no spur" to drive him except his "vaulting ambition."

cards.front: What does Lady Macbeth is cruel. "Unsex me here." mean?
cards.back: Lady Macbeth asks the spirits to "unsex me here," rejecting femininity.

cards.front: What does The witches are evil. "Fair is foul and foul is fair." mean?
cards.back: The witches' paradox that "fair is foul" establishes moral inversion.
